referenceSources.description:
A striking blue 2000 Volkswagen Golf GTi MK4 rally car, private plate JAZ 8609, competes in the Jim Clark Rally. The right-hand drive vehicle sports a full multi-point weld-in cage, four PIAA spotlights on the hood, and white rally wheels. Sponsor logos for Namik Civils and jaz computer services adorn the doors, while driver P Boyle and co-driver A Hawkins are listed on the side window.

Originally built by Ashadi RallySport in 2012 for Rally Barbados, this car went on to win the 2014 MSA REIS Asphalt Class B11 Championship and the 2014 ANEMMC Class 3 Championship. It features a fully rebuilt VW 2.0L 8-valve engine with Omex 600 series ECU, GAZ adjustable suspension, Lexan windows, Cobra seats with TRS 6-point harnesses, and a comprehensive fire safety system. Approximately 1200 miles have been covered since the rebuild, and the car remains road legal and ready for competition or display.
